title: Production list
subtitle: Prepare a plan for a selected day from sales, margin and customer orders.
formula: Proposal = average sales + margin + orders − credited stock; at least zero and never below production already received.
history_unavailable: Sales history could not be loaded.
history_not_joinable: Sales history is available, but cannot be safely joined to products.
history_requirement: The current response has a product name and sales total but no id_product. The plan is not calculated to avoid assigning quantity to the wrong product.
orders_title: Customer orders for the selected day
orders_unavailable: Customer orders could not be loaded.
orders_empty: There are no pending orders for this day.
next_title: What is needed for a complete plan
next_body: The API must return id_product for every sales-history row and quantities for the four previous occurrences of the weekday. Kitchen can then combine the average with the orders above and show the final production quantity.
save_hint: Each time you open or refresh the sheet, Planned is filled with the suggested quantities. You can edit them before clicking Save plan. Refreshing fills in the suggestion again. Saving the plan does not change stock; receiving a batch increases it. Quantities are in whole-product equivalents.
today_only: Production can only be received for today.
shift_required: Start an employee shift to receive production into stock.
tracking_disabled: Stock not established. The first production receipt establishes opening stock. Count any existing products in panel first.
unavailable: The plan could not be loaded. Please try again later.
weighted_unsupported: Weighed products require planning in units of mass and are excluded from this worksheet.
failed: Could not save. Reload data and try again.
conflict: Data changed while you were working. Reload and count the product again.
invalid_input: Enter valid quantities for the selected products.
save_first: Save plan changes before receiving a batch.
retry_hint: Result not confirmed. Retry saving; the same operation identifier will be used.
forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
date_changed: The date changed. Refresh the worksheet before saving or receiving a batch.
stock_note: The suggestion uses current stock minus reservations for other days. Production received against this plan is not deducted twice. For future dates, this is current stock, without a forecast of sales or freshness.
proposal_applied: Planned quantities were automatically filled with the current suggestion and differ from the saved plan. Check the quantities and save the plan before receiving a new batch.
production_history: History of products excluded from planning
production_history_hint: Quantities preserved from this plan. These products are excluded from new suggestions and cannot receive a new production batch.
saved_explanation: Saving the plan sets the quantities to prepare. Produced quantities and stock increase only when a batch is received.
pdf_failed: Could not download the PDF. Check that the plan is saved and try again.
no_saved_plan: No plan has been saved for this day.
saved_empty: The saved plan has no active production items.
other_saved_day: Plans belong to a specific day. Changing the displayed day does not move saved quantities.
open_latest_plan: Open the latest day with a saved plan
receive_plan_hint: Quantities contain the remaining saved plan: planned minus already received. Adjust them to actual production; zero skips a line.
saved_all: Saved successfully. Accepted lines are locked against another submission.
partial_result: Partially saved. Check each product result. Successful lines will not be submitted again.
